start_guard.contract: Startup failure: nonblocking close_intake -> interactive retry marker fsync -> legacy three-key fallback marker only on count>=2 or RUNTIME_MISSING -> best-effort destroy (2s) -> OS MessageBoxTimeoutW notice (30000ms, adapter title, first/second-failure text) -> before_exit -> os._exit(3). Noninteractive failure writes neither marker and shows no notice, logging NONINTERACTIVE. READY removes retry marker of any version; cleanup failure only logs. web_allowed and _save_fallback are unchanged v3.16.2 functions. Before app creation failures retain existing caller behavior; guard expiry remains fail-closed. Optional retry detail: exception class and numeric HRESULT only; no same-start retry under pinned-library safety exception.

exit_guard.contract: Normal close: ended owner no Future; live owner max OWNER_JOIN_S then normal adapter cleanup; timeout never auto-forces. Explicit user force watcher armed before close, existing on_force_exit join(2). Startup recovery does not call Bridge.close or wait for stopped owner. before_exit False/exception defers until True; in-process borrow0 and all lane(BROKEN included)/audit/delivery workers dead, lifetime is retained until process exit.

adapter_contract: 1. 시작: web_allowed(<data>)가 거짓이면 Tk, 참이면 웹 셸. 실제 호출은 web_allowed(data, version, write_guard=...)이며 앱 판을 준다. 셸 import 실패는 Tk(SHELL_IMPORT_FAILED).
2. 앱이 before_exit(code, deadline_s)를 준다. 일반 S01 in-process writer borrow 수0이고 모든 lane worker(BROKEN 포함)·감사·전송 worker가 죽었을 때만 True. S01 lifetime 자체는 보류 조건이 아니며 os._exit까지 보유.
3. 배포 진입 맨 앞 기다림은 없다.
4. 앱 이름을 셸 title로 주며 시작 실패 OS 안내 제목으로 쓴다.
5. lane을 띄운 실은 초기화 예외를 포함한 어떤 종료 길에서도 끝나기 전에 앱의 기존 lane 멈춤을 부른다. 정상 경로 정리를 중복 호출하지 않는다.
6. lifetime 허가가 NORMAL_DELEGATED 또는 유지보수 판이면 기존 borrow 수가 없어 before_exit는 모든 worker 종료만 확인하며 이 한계를 기록.

fallback_policy.contract: Count 1 writes retry only; count>=2 writes retry and legacy fallback. RUNTIME_MISSING starts at 2. Same version increments count; changed version starts at 1. Invalid/unreadable/symlink retry means no previous failure. READY removes retry of any version. Legacy fallback reader/writer unchanged; original v3.16.2 allows retry-only data. Session 0 or invisible station is noninteractive; API failure is interactive. Explicit udf without EBWebView uses 90s; existing EBWebView or udf=None uses 30s. Optional detail contains only exception class and optional eight-digit hexadecimal HRESULT. WEBVIEW_NO_READY identifies return without READY. MSHTML alone is not proof of runtime absence. Same-start retry intentionally omitted under M121b library-safety condition; failures counted per launch.
